title: Signal says it will restrict screenshots by default to stop AI agents from reading private chats on phones but warns its new protections are "incomplete" (Katie Paul/Reuters)
summary: Katie Paul / Reuters: Signal says it will restrict screenshots by default to stop AI agents from reading private chats on phones but warns its new protections are “incomplete” — Encrypted messaging service Signal said on Friday it would restrict screenshots to stop AI agents from reading private chats on phones …
